stance_basis: abstained from voting due to concern over Downtown Expressway impact on the area
summary: Mrs. Douglas C. Burke, a City Planning Commission member, abstained from voting on the Randolph area master plan, expressing concern about the potential impact of the proposed Downtown Expressway on the area. Her abstention signals conditional or cautious support rather than outright opposition, as she did not vote against the plan but withheld approval pending resolution of expressway-related concerns.
